title: Close out outstanding profile work

facts.text: metrics.svg, metrics.additional.svg, and metrics.extra.svg are not in the tree, and the docs no longer say those legacy files may remain.
The generative activity and community SVGs, including dark variants, and the docs showcase files the generator and docs still name, are present again.
BannerConfig width and height match the pinned banner.svg, which is 1600 by 480. The uncommitted 1200 by 630 default is reverted. Banner drawing behavior is otherwise unchanged.

The dev workflow still publishes only on refs/heads/dev. Docs and tests say a GitHub schedule loads the default branch, main, until an explicit cutover. This goal does not edit main or change the default branch.
A blog fetch error leaves the existing blog marker block unchanged. A feed that parses and is empty may say there are no posts.
generate skills and generate readme-sections exit non-zero when the README is missing or their marker pair is missing.

Supplemental generation fails when language totals or the contribution calendar are missing because collection failed. Missing Spotify, X, or WakaTime secrets omit those cards and do not fail the command.

Docs and cursor rules no longer tell you to run a missing command, import a missing module, use a missing pytest node, or build history JSON in a shape collect_history does not write. Line counts change only in files edited for another fact.

Word-cloud prompt and techs runs honor --renderer. A markdown run without --output-path does not write a non-typographic render over wordcloud_typographic_by_topics.svg or wordcloud_typographic_by_languages.svg.
preview skills does not modify the working-tree README. preview generative does not exit only because no metrics file was passed.
generate animated passes timeline=False for every style, and exits non-zero when no metrics file is given and the profile is not one of the mock profiles.
generate all runs WakaTime when WAKATIME_API_KEY is set, and continues without failing when that key is absent.
A WakaTime project is kept only when its exact public owner/name matches. A shared short name such as docs does not make another owner's private project public.
LOG_LEVEL controls the Loguru console level. DEBUG_MODE is either honored or removed from the documented controls.
The Spotify refresh-token output path is gitignored, and the callback server rejects every host other than 127.0.0.1, localhost, and ::1.
The manual metrics probe does not upload probe SVGs as Actions artifacts and does not pass METRICS_TOKEN into lowlighter/metrics.
SHIPPED_STYLE_KEYS stays the same six styles as the candidates. bakeoff.json has no accepted key. Living-art GIFs and the pinned banner pair are not regenerated.

These stay unfinished and are not marked done: classic PAT revoke, Actions billing lock, living-art accepted[], production Redis approval tasks 5.1 through 5.4, live badge Camo check 3.2, and remote updater proof 9.5. .env and .claude/settings.local.json are not edited.
dev receives a cleaned Python lock bump from PR #12 and only Actions pins newer than dev today. PR #12 and PR #14 are closed. main is not changed. setup-uv on dev is not downgraded.
